review_candidates.title: Senior Backup & Business Continuity Engineer/Specialist
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Senior Backup & Business Continuity Specialist Job Summary We are looking for a Senior Backup & Business Continuity Specialist to design, implement, and maintain reliable backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity solutions. Key Responsibilities * Design, implement, and manage enterprise backup and recovery solutions. * Develop and maintain Disaster Recovery (DR) and Business Continuity (BC) plans. * Define and maintain RPO (Recovery Point Objective) and RTO (Recovery Time Objective) req
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: * Define and maintain RPO (Recovery Point Objective) and RTO (Recovery Time Objective) requirements. * Ensure backup solutions meet security, compliance, and business requirements. Requirements * 5+ years of experience in Backup, Disaster Recovery, Business Continuity, Infrastructure, or a related field. * Strong hands-on experience with enterprise backup and recovery solutions. Preferred Certifications * Veeam certifications * VMware certifications * Microsoft / Azure certifications * AWS certifications * Business Continuity / Disaster Recovery certifications such as CBCI, MBCI, or equivalent Soft Skills * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
